faq_heading: New Westminster condos under $600,000: your questions answered

faq.q: How many New Westminster condos sell for under $600,000?
faq.a: 183 of 624, or 29%. A further 356 sold in the next range up, $600,000 to $799,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a condo in New Westminster?
faq.a: $570,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $600,000 is above the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $485,000 and $680,000.

faq.q: Which New Westminster area has the lowest condo prices?
faq.a: Downtown, at $519,900 across 133 sales at $662 a square foot, median year built 2007. The highest of the 7 lowest was Queensborough at $690,000.

faq.q: How fast do New Westminster condos sell?
faq.a: 29 days at the median, closing at 97.2% of the last list price, with 7% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $600,000).

In New Westminster, 183 of the 624 condos (29%) sold under $600,000. The median was $570,000, with the middle half between $485,000 and $680,000. The busiest price range, $600,000 to $799,999, had 356 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a condo under $600,000 in New Westminster

In Downtown the median condo sold for $519,900 across 133 sales, $80,100 under $600,000. Across New Westminster the median condo took 29 days to sell and closed at 97.2% of the last list price, with 7% of the 624 sales above list. Check the strata fee and depreciation report.
